title: Immunofluorescence Microscopy Detection of ssDNA Foci by BrdU in Mammalian Cells
author: Kilgas, Kiltie, et al.

steps.title: Detach cells with Trypsin‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Detach T24 cells from T75 flasks using 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate a few minutes at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in a Class II biosafety cabinet; pre‑warm medium and trypsin, check morphology, sterilize forceps and coverslips with 70 % ethanol or autoclave. Alternative: scrape with sterile scrapers in PBS or PBS‑EDTA (3 mM).

steps.title: Neutralize, collect and seed cells
steps.instruction: Neutralize trypsin by adding ≥2 volumes of complete McCoy’s 5A medium with 10 % FBS, transfer cells to a Falcon tube, centrifuge at 900–1,000 × g, 20–22 °C for 3–4 min, gently aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in complete medium, count cells with 1:1 trypan blue using a hemocytometer, and seed 0.4 × 10⁶ cells per well of a 6‑well plate (final volume 2 mL) containing a sterilized 9 mm No.1 cover glass pressed to the bottom; aim for 50–60 % confluence the next day.

steps.title: Label DNA with BrdU and EdU
steps.instruction: Next day add 10 µM BrdU to the culture and incubate 24 h; optionally add other compounds (e.g., 500 µM HU for 1 h before processing). Twenty minutes before fixation add 10 µM EdU to the same medium, incubate 20 min, then remove BrdU/EdU‑containing media.

steps.title: Induce DNA damage by irradiation
steps.instruction: Irradiate cells with 2 Gy ionising radiation (IR); keep non‑irradiated wells as controls. After IR, incubate cells in complete medium at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for the desired recovery time before fixation. Do not exceed 4 Gy total dose; alternatives include gamma/X‑ray irradiators or radiomimetic drugs (bleomycin, neocarzinostatin).

steps.title: Pre‑extraction and fixation
steps.instruction: Transfer each cover glass to an individual well of a 12‑well plate, wash with 1 mL ice‑cold 1× PBS, aspirate, add 1 mL ice‑cold pre‑extraction buffer and incubate 5 min on ice (handle gently to avoid detachment). Aspirate, wash once with 1 mL cold PBS, add 1 mL freshly prepared ice‑cold 4 % PFA in PBS, incubate 10 min at 20‑22 °C, then wash twice with 1 mL PBS at 20‑22 °C for 2–3 min each.

steps.title: Primary BrdU antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute BrdU antibody 1:300 in 2.5 % BSA/PBS. Place 30 µL droplets of this solution on parafilm in a wet chamber. Invert each cover glass (fixed side up) onto a droplet, incubate 1 h at 20‑22 °C in the dark. Transfer coverslips back to the 12‑well plate, add 1 mL PBS at 20‑22 °C for 5 min, remove with a vacuum pump; repeat the PBS wash two more times (total three washes).

steps.title: Secondary Alexa Fluor 488 incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody in antibody dilution buffer, place 30 µL droplets on parafilm, invert coverslips onto droplets, incubate 1 h at 20‑22 °C in the dark, then wash three times with 1 mL PBS at 20‑22 °C for 5 min each.

steps.title: Optional Cyclin A staining
steps.instruction: Dilute Cyclin A antibody 1:500 in 2.5 % BSA/PBS, repeat the primary‑antibody droplet, incubation, and three PBS washes as in the BrdU primary step. Then dilute Alexa Fluor 594 secondary antibody in antibody dilution buffer and repeat the secondary‑antibody droplet, 1 h incubation, and three PBS washes.

steps.title: Pause point (optional overnight)
steps.instruction: Coverslips can remain in primary antibody solution at 4 °C overnight (~16 h) in a wet chamber, ensuring the solution does not dry.

steps.title: Image acquisition and Fiji analysis
steps.instruction: Open CZI files in Fiji (drag‑and‑drop). In the DAPI channel use the wand tool, set tolerance, enable thresholding, and add each nucleus to the ROI Manager (press ‘t’ or click ‘Add’). Switch to the FITC (BrdU) channel, choose Process → Find Maxima, set Output type to ‘single points’, adjust Prominence until individual foci are identified with minimal background, then click ‘Find Maxima’ and ‘Measure’ for each ROI. Calculate the number of foci by dividing the RawIntDen value by the Max value. Keep identical threshold settings across all conditions and do not modify image contrast or intensity.

steps.title: Statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Perform statistical analysis using GraphPad Prism 8; consider p ≤ 0.05 as statistically significant.
